environment.name: OTEL_CONFIG
environment.value:
extensions:
  basicauth/openobserve:
    client_auth:
      username: ${env:OPENOBSERVE_USERNAME}
      password: ${env:OPENOBSERVE_PASSWORD}

receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
        endpoint: ${env:NOMAD_ADDR_service}
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
        - job_name: nomad
          scrape_interval: 15s
          metrics_path: /v1/metrics
          params:
            format: [prometheus]
          static_configs:
            - targets: ["${env:NOMAD_TARGET}"]

processors:
  batch: {}

exporters:
  otlphttp/openobserve:
    endpoint: http://${env:OPENOBSERVE_HOST}:${env:OPENOBSERVE_PORT}/api/default
    auth:
      authenticator: basicauth/openobserve

service:
  extensions: [basicauth/openobserve]
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlphttp/openobserve]
    logs:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlphttp/openobserve]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp, prometheus]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlphttp/openobserve]
